disqualifier.note: Inline Effect RpcClient.Protocol service object. supportsAck and supportsTransferables are independent fields of effect/unstable/rpc Protocol; this HTTP layer writes both false, and Effect's own socket/worker protocols use other pairs.

Second instantiation of the same Effect RpcClient.Protocol contract on the NDJSON layer. Both flags are SDK transport capabilities and are written false together here; upstream Effect protocols also write true/false and true/true.
